title: Unchanged Short Pullback Candidate Qualification
decision_basis: Research/Core parity passed at 500 of 500 with zero row-field mismatch.
Rakuten-native 2023-2024 execution remained a binding exact-portability failure because 242 algorithm or information-time mismatches remained and only 417 of 500 event keys were common.
At explicit user direction the unchanged candidate proceeded to its first 2025H1 validation-period execution without retuning or candidate modification.
The 2025H1 standalone candidate produced 172 trades, JPY 3,483 net and PF 1.12615.
Adding the candidate improved baseline net from JPY -20,808 to JPY -17,325 but worsened full-equity drawdown from JPY 42,737 to JPY 46,281.
The positive validation evidence does not waive the historical portability failure and does not authorize portfolio, production or live adoption.
exact_next_action: Preserve HYP-039 as closed portability failure with valid positive 2025H1 economic evidence. Do not reopen, retune, deploy or include it in the authorized common portfolio under this candidate identity.
